notes.title: Newest Update now online!
notes.notes:
Today, we have updated the game "CarsFuckingDragons"!! CELEBRATION!!

What is new, might you ask? We added controller configuration that when you go into the MENU OPTIONS (Dashboard) with your controller, it will have CONTROLLER CONFIGURATION. Additionally, we added the same with KEYBOARD CONFIGURATION (called Keyboard Config). I recommend hitting "WASD movement layout which will also give you character movement for arrow keys.

I want to say a HEARTFELT Thank You for supporting the game and the gaming studio. We have released other games in the meantime but coming back to this to have a working copy and give it a update is actually a pretty big thing! 

AND THE GAME IS CURRENTLY ON SALE FOR THE STEAM WINTER SALE!!  



-Necro
--NECROCATICGAMES--
